shard.title: Subject: Terrorism
shard.basis: the publisher's subject list, from gssrdoc in the current release (7224r3a)

name: done911a
label: Has R developed emergency plans

questions.text:
Do you know anyone who has done any of the following things because of terrorism since September 11th, 2001?) 
Have you, or anyone you know developed emergency plans (evacuation, meeting places)? 
FI PROBE: IF RESPONDENT ANSWERS 'YES,' ASK; 'Was this you, someone you know, or both yourself and someone you know?

values.label: yes, both respondent and someone respondent knows

name: eff911a
label: How effective R thinks developing emergency plans

questions.text:
How effective do you think developing emergency plans (evacuation, meeting places) is for people dealing with  terrorism? 
Would you say 1, not at all effective, 5, extremely effective, or you may use any number in between?
